howto: Pick Easy, Normal, Hard or Daily drops and press Play.
Tap a column (or press 1 to 6) to drop the Next block into it.
Two touching blocks with the same number merge into one twice as big; merges can chain.
The game ends when every column is full.
tips: Keep your biggest numbers along the bottom row.
A drop that sets off a chain scores every merge in it.
Hint plays every column in a copy of the board and picks the best one.
Undo takes back a drop and every merge it caused.

controls.keyboard: 1 to 6 drop in a column, Z undoes, H hints. P or Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Tap a column. Undo and Hint sit in the top bar.

difficulty: Easy gives 3 undos, Normal 1 and Hard none, and on Hard the next block can also be an 8. Daily drops is Normal with the same blocks for everyone today.

cheats.effect: Big drop: every new block is an 8
Clear top: the top two rows are wiped

features.hints: Hint button (or H, or Pause > Hint): simulates every column with all its merges, highlights the best one and says what it scores
features.undo: Undo button (or Z): 3 on Easy, 1 on Normal and Daily, none on Hard
features.level-select-or-daily: Easy, Normal and Hard on the title, plus Daily drops with the same blocks for everyone each day
features.results: Game Over card with score, best, megas, level, streak, medals and lifetime blocks
